digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira_family - shared Jira backend seam layer
propositions: Jira Data Center requires separate integration from Cloud due to REST v2 vs v3, wiki-markup vs ADF, PAT vs ACLI, and name-based vs accountId identity
PR #120 forked the Cloud adapter verbatim, creating unmaintained field-map and sanitizer duplication with no enforced contract between Cloud and DC backends
Extract shared Jira family layer (jira_family/) containing single definitions of value maps, label sanitizer, link relations, and identity/codec contracts parameterized by deployment type
Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) must remain at their paths for dynamic loader but may import from jira_family to eliminate duplication
DC transport requires https by default, rejects insecure urls unless allow_insecure=true is explicitly set with warning, and never disables TLS certificate verification
Resolved workflow-state names are operator-configurable via reconciler.resolved_statuses (defaults to Cloud's {Resolved, Done, Cancelled}) to prevent misclassification of DC issues
